**Judgment-day on PR #331 (issue #210): 12 confirmed findings, 6 CRITICAL — PR documents a fix it never implements**

**What**: Blind dual review (jd-judge-a + jd-judge-b, both opus) of PR #331 `fix/issue-210-fixgovernance-releaseyml-audit-gate-cann`. 12 confirmed findings, 0 contradictions. Verdict: NOT approvable — 6 confirmed CRITICALs.

**Why**: PR #331 claimed to fix issue #210 (release.yml audit-gate runs after the tag exists). It ships ADR-0025 + spec + tasks asserting an audit-then-tag pipeline that no code implements.

**Confirmed by both judges**:
1. No tag-creation step exists anywhere in release.yml. REQ-210-1 and ADR-0025 Decision 1 unimplemented.
2. `push: tags: ['v*']` still present. design.md said "replaces" — it ADDS workflow_dispatch alongside. Issue #210 root cause #1 untouched.
3. `tag_name` input declared, never referenced; `required: false` while spec mandates required. Silent no-op: a maintainer dispatching with tag_name sees green and no tag is created.
4. REQ-210-4 / ADR Decision 3 false: `substrate.mjs` evalRung2 (lines 76-90) untouched, still a pure presence probe (release.yml exists OR governance.releaseGate===true).
5. **Tier 3 governance violation**: ADR-0025 committed straight to `brain/project/decisions/` with `Status: Accepted`, bypassing the `openspec/changes/{iid}/brain-drafts/` -> human promotion flow required by ADR-0013 and `brain/core/anti-patterns/ia-escribe-brain-sin-gate.md`. The PR body falsely claims a brain-drafts/ file that is not in the diff.
6. Zero tests added. `release-postmerge-workflows.test.mjs` still asserts `push tags: ['v*']` and `permissions: {contents: read}` and passes 27/27 — proof the contract did not change. tasks.md marks all 4 items [x].
7. `auditBaseline: "v1.0.0"` is INERT going forward: v1.0.0 is the latest tag, so in `v1.0.0..HEAD` every merge has it as ancestor -> zero [SKIP]. Does not fix root cause #2.
8. `permissions: {contents: read}` makes the tag push the ADR promises structurally impossible; PR body brags about preserving it — self-contradiction.
9. release.yml header now false in 3 places ("only ever runs on a tag push"; "primary enforcing guarantee"; the Range note). The `# exit 1 blocks the tag/publish — fail closed.` comment was deleted, leaving 2 trailing blank lines.
10. `REF_TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-HEAD}"` — GITHUB_REF_NAME is always set, so `:-HEAD` is dead code. On workflow_dispatch it is the BRANCH name, so `git describe --tags --abbrev=0 "main^"` drops HEAD's own commit and can re-audit an already-released window.
11. `setup-node@v4` pinned to '22' only here; governance.yml and governance-postmerge.yml rely on the runner default -> version skew between gates.
12. Missing `GH_TOKEN`/`VCS_TOKEN` (PRE-EXISTING on main). Both sibling governance workflows wire `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}`; release.yml does not. Without it the prView PR-body fetch fails, issueLink falls back to the raw `Merge pull request #N` body and goes red — the exact issue #210 failure. Judge B verified it only passes today because csrinaldi/brain is now PUBLIC; in the free-tier-private case (the whole reason Rung 2 exists) the permanent red returns.

**Suspect (one judge only)**: workflow_dispatch has no branch restriction (A); `git describe --tags` lacks `--match 'v*'` and could select the existing `archive/d2-pr3-superseded-9233880` tag (B); proposal.md names the input `version` vs `tag_name` elsewhere (B); ADR `Status: Accepted` while proposal.md says `Draft` (B).

**Where**: `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `brain.config.json`, `brain/project/decisions/adr-0025-release-audit-gate-ordering.md`, `openspec/changes/issue-210-fixgovernance-releaseyml-audit-gate-cann/*`, `brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs:76-90`, `brain/scripts/vcs/release-postmerge-workflows.test.mjs:153-181`.

**Learned**: Only REQ-210-3 landed, and it was already satisfied by pre-existing code in `brain-audit.mjs:255` — the PR only populates the config value. The green test suite was the tell: a suite that passes identically before and after a change advertised as a re-architecture proves the contract never moved. This is the same failure mode as issue #328 (stale-green gates) — a checklist of [x] over undone work.

**Note**: `brain:review` could NOT be run — `BRAIN_REVIEWER_TOKEN` still unset (see the earlier "reviewer NOT actually wired" memory). Review was done manually + judgment-day. No skill registry exists in repo or engram, so `Skill Resolution: none`.</content>
